title: Chapter 1093
text:
After releasing the two captives, Han Xiao did not leave Planet Black Gate immediately. Instead, he called the person in charge of the planet over and asked him to accompany him to inspect the orbital structure of Planet Black Gate. He also provided some guidance.

On the way back, Han Xiao inspected the operation of the stargate toll booths.

The stargate transportation network in the Black Star Corps' territory was connected from the Garu Star Cluster to the free competition zone. It was convenient, fast, and one of the few complete transportation routes in the Flickering World.

Of course, outsiders would have to pay a fee if they wanted to use this stargate route. Han Xiao fully utilized the talent of the Chinese to build roads if they wanted to get rich. He had set up a toll booth at every section of the stargate. This was a true example of 'this road is opened by me, but you have to pay the toll'.

With such a natural treasure trove, the army had already earned back the cost of building the stargate in less than a year after the opening of the Flickering World. Such a terrifying profit margin fully proved one truth — how could the profits of doing business compare to the profits of occupying land?

After returning to the Black Star Palace, the first payment for the ransom of Radiance and Ethereal was sent over. Radiance had paid the most. The three Gold Grade blueprints were all provided by him. This time, he handed over the information of the first Gold Grade blueprint.

"Mechanical Deity exclusive weapon, Universal Treasure level mechanical creation, Celestial Punishment Edge."

In his office, Han Xiao chewed on a lava-flavored concentrated nutrition bar while looking at the blueprints sent over by the Radiant Federation.

The blueprints that Radiance had taken out for exchange were mostly for Super weapons used in combat. This was one of the blueprints that Han Xiao had chosen.

According to the notes of the Radiant Federation, this was an idea proposed by the fanatical worshippers of the Mechanical Deity in the Saint Tyracles Race. Radiance had inherited their knowledge and modified it, incorporating some unique technology, and finally turned this incomplete idea into a blueprint.

The complete design of this weapon was drawn on the blueprint, and it had some similarities to the technology of the Emperor's Cape. Its appearance was a long mechanical blade with a complicated structure. It had powerful close combat technology, and at the same time, it could transform into a giant cannon form and launch a variety of long-range attacks. Its power was just like its name, and the foundation was the Star Destroyer.

The Celestial Punishment Edge was similar to the Emperor's Cape, and the Armed Class was more proficient in it. Although Han Xiao was in the Virtual Class, he could also build it with the knowledge of all classes.

"But why is this style so strange? Wearing a battle robe and holding a large sword. Next time, give me a Mechanical Red Hare, and I can play the role of the mechanical version of Guan Yu …"

Han Xiao complained inwardly.

Speaking of which, why are these Saint Tyracles so fond of designing close-combat weapons? As expected, every qualified mechanic has a Pugilist's soul hidden in their hearts.

Although he cursed in his heart, he still had to make the item. Han Xiao told Philip to add the raw materials for the Celestial Punishment Edge to the next purchase list.

After settling this matter, Han Xiao checked Philip's message box.

Not long ago, the neutral Beyond Grade A members who were hired by the Supercluster had replied. Most of them were worried that they would become the target of the Dark Emperor's order to kill them. Only a few did not care.

"It's easy as long as there's a need."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He chatted with these Beyond Grade As for a while, including the 'Head of Golems' Garoze, who had been scared away by him before.

He hinted slightly, and these people immediately understood. They clearly expressed their willingness to support Black Star as much as possible in the development union in the future.

Most of these Beyond Grade As did not want to join the three Universal Civilizations because they did not want to be restricted. However, this would not work in the development union. They were only ordinary members in the association, and their right to speak was limited. Therefore, they needed an upper echelon with power to represent their interests and get better treatment for them. This was a two-way deal, and both sides would benefit from each other.

A few Beyond Grade As, including Garoze, agreed to publicly raise this proposal in the next plenary meeting. Han Xiao promised to work on this matter and eliminate the threat they faced.

After roping in this group of people, Han Xiao turned around and contacted the dynasty, preparing to inform them first.

He expressed his intention, and after waiting for a while, the secretary transferred the communication to Uranril.

Han Xiao's remote projection appeared in the Dynasty Ruler's office, and in front of him was Uranril, who was sitting behind the table.

"Your Excellency Ruler." Han Xiao nodded in greeting.

"Black Star." Uranril also greeted him. She stared into Han Xiao's eyes and went straight to the point. "You want me to call Clottey back?"

"Yes, the purpose of the development union is to eliminate the conflict between Beyond Grade As. Now that Clottey is an Honorary Director, if he attacks a member again, it will go against the purpose of the association …"

Uranril was expressionless. "In what capacity are you making this suggestion to me today, as an ally of the dynasty or as the vice president of the development union?"

Han Xiao did not bat an eyelid. "Both," he said.

"Black Star, how do you think the dynasty has treated you over the past few decades?"

"Win-win." Han Xiao smiled.

Uranril paused for a moment before slowly saying, "I have to remind you that the Evolutionary Totem business and the territory in the Flickering World are all benefits that only allies can enjoy. The dynasty values you very much, and you know this very well."

Some things were not easy to say. The dynasty did not object to Black Star becoming the vice president of the development union, but they did not want to see Black Star's butt being too crooked. They hoped that between the two identities of being an ally of the dynasty and being the vice president, his position would be more inclined to the former.

The Mecha Empire was an example. They had made too many contributions, and the Radiance had no choice but to reward them time and time again. As a result, the Mecha Empire grew stronger and broke away from their control. The dynasty did not want to create a second Mecha Empire.

Han Xiao pretended that he did not hear Uranril's words and said, "Clottey captured Traveler and another Beyond Grade A, reawakening the fear of others toward him. In fact, the mission has already been completed. If he continues to deal with others, it will be too much. Plus, when I was in the secondary dimensions, I even helped him. Otherwise, there would have been more accidents. "

"Hmm … that makes sense," Uranril said.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he said, "Clottey should have reported the results of Traveler's interrogation. Sorokin also interfered behind the scenes. I wonder if the dynasty has put him on the Dark Emperor's list of punishments?"

"The authenticity of the testimony still needs to be verified. Sorokin's motives are unclear, and Clottey is not suitable to appear." Uranril waved her hands. "If the evidence is conclusive, the dynasty will deal with him."

Hearing this, Han Xiao secretly gloated.

Sorokin had been moving between the three Universal Civilizations, and now that Traveler had pushed the blame to him, there would be a huge problem in the situation he had worked so hard to manage.

He did not know if the dynasty would use force like how they dealt with Traveler. If that was the case, Sorokin's hidden strength would be exposed.

The two of them talked for a while. Uranril did not give a definite answer, only saying that she would consider terminating the Dark Emperor's mission. Han Xiao knew when to stop and politely left.

…

A few days later, on Planet Finn, the headquarters of the Beyond Grade A association …

In the round table conference room, the remote projections of nearly a hundred Beyond Grade A members gathered for a routine plenary meeting.

The development union was currently consolidating resources, and the focus of the discussion was the cooperation plans of the various Beyond Grade As.

The atmosphere was lively. Everyone was a reputable figure, and they each expressed their own opinions. There was no bureaucratic style. Everyone put forward their own interests, then exchanged interests with the members who had different resources, slowly integrating each business and building a huge network of interests. For ordinary Beyond Grade As, this was a great opportunity to cooperate with other large Beyond Grade A organizations. As long as they were supported, they would be able to obtain huge profits.

After talking about the daily affairs, Manison changed the topic and said, "I'm not sure what to do.

"In the next meeting, the development union will introduce two new members, Tolaen and Hades. Due to some personal reasons, they missed the opportunity to establish the association. Now that the procedures have been completed, they will attend the next meeting."

Everyone could not help but look at Han Xiao, who was sitting in the deputy's seat. Everyone present knew about the 'personal reasons' for Tolaen and Hades' absence. The room was suddenly filled with a happy atmosphere.

Then, Manison looked around and slowly said, "If there are no other questions, this meeting will end here …"

This time, Garoze raised his hand and said, "I have a question for Honorary Director Clottey."

Hearing this, everyone looked over. Clottey, who had been silent, also opened his eyes and glanced around.

"I want to confirm one thing. Everyone is now a member of the association and is bound by the rules and regulations. Your Excellency Clottey can't do anything to the members, right?"

"I only listen to the dynasty's orders." Clottey was expressionless, not buying it at all.

The atmosphere suddenly became strange. The direct members of the three Universal Civilizations, who were resting with their eyes closed, opened their eyes one after another, revealing interested expressions.

Garoze mustered up his courage and said with a deep voice, "I hope the association can handle this matter and ensure our safety. I don't want His Excellency Dark Emperor to suddenly accuse me of a non-existent crime and attack us."

As soon as he said that, several neutral Beyond Grade As spoke one after another, expressing their support for this statement. This was obviously premeditated.

"Hmm …" Manison narrowed his eyes.

The current structure of the association was delicate. Although these direct members of the three Universal Civilizations had joined the association, it was obviously impossible for them to listen to the association's mediation. This proposal brought the conflict to the surface.

Although these neutral Beyond Grade As' requests were reasonable, they were beyond the current scope of the association's ability. He did not have the right to make Clottey stop.

However, the purpose of the development union was to mediate conflicts between Beyond Grade As, so it had to be carried out to the end. Manison could not say that he could not do it, or it would shake the foundation of the association and make people worry about the association's ability to enforce its own rules.

"I'll try my best …"

Manison was about to agree first and think of a way later.

However, before he could finish his sentence, Han Xiao suddenly interrupted and said, "What's wrong?

"Leave this problem to me. I'll handle it."

Garoze and the others understood and all thanked Han Xiao. "We'll leave it to Your Excellency Black Star. We'll wait for your good news."

Clottey gave Han Xiao a deep look and did not say anything.

Han Xiao smiled at Clottey and did not intend to speak either. Both of them knew that the person who could make the decision was not here.

Han Xiao even pretended to comfort Garoze, putting on a good show.

At this moment, Manison, who was next to him, realized what was going on and gave him a meaningful look.

Manison did not mind Han Xiao establishing the right to speak. The way he saw it, Black Star was on the same side as him. As long as he could do something, everything was negotiable.

…

Seven days later, Clottey received an order from the dynasty Ruler to stop the mission and leave the Flickering World with the captives.

This news quickly spread to the ears of all the members, and in their hearts, Han Xiao's reliability increased by a notch.

Black Star had taken the initiative to take over this matter and successfully resolved it, proving his ability. Others knew that he had the ability to handle things and would naturally respect him. This principle was applicable everywhere.

To Han Xiao, this was just a small episode that did not cost him much effort. As his position rose, his opinion could more and more easily influence the decisions of the dynasty's upper echelons on some unimportant issues. The dynasty Ruler still gave him face and increased the authority of the dynasty's ally as the vice president. This was naturally better than him being controlled by Manison of Radiance.

On the other hand, Aurora had already mastered the eighteen positions of controlling the Holy Light Particle after more than half a month of experimenting. Han Xiao did not delay and immediately announced the existence of the Holy Light Particle to the outside world. He emphasized the new system of the Holy Light Seed and announced that as long as one was an army member, they would be able to exchange for the Holy Light Seed.

The new source of power attracted the interest of the players and Supers, but it was only interest. The ones who had the biggest reaction were the ordinary people.

Almost everyone hoped to have power that surpassed ordinary people. This was the shortest path to breaking through the ranks. As long as they awakened it, they would immediately become a Super with special privileges.

However, everyone was born different. Limited by their talent, most people were destined to be ordinary for the rest of their lives.

Now, an opportunity to change their fate was right in front of them, and the hope was not slim. As long as they worked for the Black Star Corps and accumulated enough Contribution, they would have a hundred percent chance of obtaining extraordinary power!

As soon as the announcement was released, countless ordinary people went crazy. The sensation it created was even more terrifying than all the previous deeds of the army. The previous deeds were just deeds, but this announcement was closely related to everyone's interests.

Ordinary people had their own way of living. Even if they knew how powerful the Black Star Corps was, there were still very few people who were willing to apply for a job in a warlord organization. However, everything was different now. The attraction of the Black Star Corps to ordinary people instantly surpassed that of ninety-nine percent of the industries.

In just five days, the number of ordinary people who applied to join the army surpassed the total number of people in the Black Star Corps!

The number of ordinary people in the entire universe far exceeded the number of Supers.

…

In a secret research base of the Holy Covenant Organization.

A researcher placed a cooler in front of Law and Fay, opened the lid, reached into the white cold air, and took out a device that looked like a small radar.

"Your Excellencies, this is a detection device that I developed using the characteristics of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. It's specifically used to detect the Holy Light Particle."

Law clapped his hands encouragingly. "Good job. This way, we can look for the Holy Light Particle."

"The Holy Light Particle has not appeared for many years. It's probably sleeping in some secondary dimension and is now ownerless. This is our chance. Is the detection range of this device large enough?"

The researcher had a confident expression.

"Don't worry, this device can work with a cross-dimensional detection radar. It's definitely enough."

"That's good." Fay nodded in satisfaction.

"Quickly equip it," Law urged. "We need to get the Holy Light Particle as soon as possible."

"Understood, I'll …"

Before he could finish speaking, an adjutant hurriedly ran in with a communicator in his hand and said anxiously, "Sir,

"Your — Your Excellencies, look at this news."

Law and Fei leaned over to take a look and were dumbfounded.

The image on the communicator was the announcement that Han Xiao had made.

"We're done for …"

Law mumbled to himself.

Not only the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, but even the Holy Light Particle was obtained by Black Star?

What kind of luck was this?

They successfully attacked Black Star last time because the other party was not prepared and did not understand their weapons.

The two of them originally thought that they would never have to deal with Black Star again, so they were very relieved. However, they did not expect that Black Star had another Primal Esper Ability that they needed.

The two of them looked at each other and saw the helplessness in each other's eyes.

It would have been better if it was another Beyond Grade A, but why did it have to be Black Star?

Now that Black Star was prepared, the risk of taking action again was at least ten times higher. They were probably dreaming if they wanted to ambush him again.

"… Are we still going to rob him?"

"Don't drag me down if you want to die." Fay's tone was filled with disdain.

"Then what do we do? The Holy Light Particle is in his hands. We have to find a way to get it back."

"How would I know?"

The two of them were about to explode.

What should we do?

The researcher looked around and could not help but ask.

"Erm … do we still need to install this detection device that I developed?"

"What do you think?"
